detail: Attended the grammar school in his home town of Topoľčany, graduating in 1982.

institution: Faculty of Law, Comenius University in Bratislava (Právnická fakulta Univerzity Komenského)
detail: Graduated in law in 1986, specialising in criminal law and human rights according to TASR.

institution: Judicial practice and judicial examinations (Slovak justice system)
qualification: Judicial examination (qualification to serve as a judge)
detail: According to TASR he completed judicial practice and the judicial examinations, which qualify a candidate for the office of judge, in 1987–1988.

institution: Institute of State and Law, Slovak Academy of Sciences (Ústav štátu a práva SAV)
qualification: Candidate of Sciences (CSc.); later habilitated as docent (associate professor) in 2002
detail: Postgraduate study in criminal law leading to the CSc. degree; Wikipedia gives the thesis topic as the death penalty in Czechoslovakia. TASR reports that he habilitated as docent in 2002, without naming the awarding institution.
